'''Arts and culture'''
*[[Major Archbishop]] [[Sviatoslav Shevchuk]] of the [[Ukrainian Greek Catholic Church]] announces that the church will begin using the [[Gregorian calendar]] on September 1 for all but [[moveable feast]]s, following a decision by the Synod of Bishops. [https://ugcc.ua/en/data/historical-decision-the-ugcc-in-ukraine-switches-to-a-new-calendar-232/ (UGCC)]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
* [[2023 Turkey–Syria earthquake]]
**At least 59,000 people are killed in [[Turkey]] and [[Syria]] as a magnitude 7.8 [[earthquake]] strikes [[Gaziantep Province]], Turkey. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-64533851 (BBC News)]
**A second earthquake of magnitude 7.5 occurs in [[Marash|Kahramanmaraş]], [[Turkey]], nine hours after the first earthquake. [https://www.bloomberg.com/news/articles/2023-02-06/turkey-s-south-hit-by-a-second-high-magnitude-earthquake (Bloomberg)]
*[[2023 Coulson Aviation crash]]
**A [[Boeing 737-300]] firefighting tanker crashes in [[Fitzgerald River National Park]] in [[Western Australia]]. Both pilots survive. [https://7news.com.au/news/disaster-and-emergency/firefighting-aircraft-crashes-in-was-great-southern-c-9671802 (7 News)]
*[[Landslide]]s triggered by heavy rains causes [[mudslides]] across villages in the [[Camaná Province]], [[Peru]], killing 36 people. [https://apnews.com/article/landslides-and-mudslides-caribbean-peru-de8ed0ec4bfb9d7f1af42ac96d4e3a70 (AP)]
